name: Bursts
description: 80 MHz around the knob's frequency without a gap (the WHY2025 badge's C6 keeps the 10 us windows that stand out), channelized on the P4 into 40 channels of 2 MHz with a burst detector per channel: each channel's power over its floor, occupancy over time, and the bursts that ended with their frequency, length and level.
author: esp-sdr
